evaluatorEntrypoints.hooks-syntax: fail=0; for f in config/hooks/*.cjs; do node --check "$f" 2>/dev/null || { echo "SYNTAX FAIL: $f"; fail=$((fail+1)); }; done; echo "hooks-checked: $(ls config/hooks/*.cjs | wc -l)  failures: $fail"; [ "$fail" -eq 0 ] && echo HOOKS-SYNTAX-OK || echo HOOKS-SYNTAX-FAIL

extraDisciplines: self-referential: agentbox contains the dream-engine that dreams it (services/dream-engine). A change to that crate changes the dreamer itself — apply extra review scrutiny, and never let a self-modifying hypothesis bypass the human-merge gate. Still evidence-gated, still witnessed.

nix-build-out-of-annexe: the full image build (flake.nix) needs nixpkgs and the host build shell (tmux tab 6) — the HP annexe cannot run it. The evaluable surface here is the Rust crates + node hook syntax. Record image/Nix findings as 'HANDOFF (rebuild):' notes; never invent a nix-build evaluator that would silently no-op.

sibling-path-deps-fenced: services/nostr-pod-bridge path-deps the nostr-rust-forum and solid-pod-rs sibling repos (../../../../), which are NOT in the annexe clone, so that crate cannot build here. Do not evaluate or propose changes to it or its sibling crates — handoff to those repos' own cycles.
secrets-never-in-report: agentbox holds keys and env; never quote .env, agentbox/.env, or any *_KEY/*_PRIVKEY value into a report, ledger, or gist.
